name: desk_hook_hard
format: textspot6-pages samples of 1a (src hook, kind desktop): train/tsdesk_det.py treats an extra source named desk_hook_* as desk_hook

rule.score: main lines missed or cut plus boxes merging two or more lines, by the detector before the reading filter (line_status on even cells)
rule.per_vn_key: the VNDB id, or the title for a hooked title without one
rule.order: score, the failed share of the main lines, a salted hash

note: shards hold copyrighted frames and stay local; this manifest holds names, counts, sha256 and VNDB ids
